```text
# PR #2937: Patch: unsquish the game-over screen's "Their hand" cards on a phone

Closes #2933

## What changed and why

**[`apps/web/src/game/reveal.css`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2933/apps/web/src/game/reveal.css)** — three rules, one root cause deeper than the issue's guess:

1. `.their-hand__card` now sizes both axes from one token (`--their-hand-h: 92px`, `width: calc(var(--their-hand-h) * 5 / 7)`); the phone media query sets the token to 66px so width follows. `aspect-ratio` is gone — no box dimension derives from it anymore.
2. New `.their-hand__card > .cf { width: 100%; height: 100%; }` so the face fills the button exactly.
3. New `.app-shell .their-hand__card { padding: 0; }` — this was the actual sliver. `.app-shell button` ([`index.css`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2933/apps/web/src/index.css:338)) pads every button 9px 16px at specificity (0,1,1), beating the card's `padding: 0` (0,1,0). The button measured a correct 47×66 while the face squeezed into the 15px content box. Live-measured before: buttons 47×66, faces 15×48; after: buttons 47.1×66, faces 47.1×66, names 44px wide.

**[`e2e/cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx`](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner-fill-2/_work/_temp/work/item-2933/e2e/cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx)** (new) — layout spec mounting the finished game with the real catalog: face is 5:7 within 1px, fills the button on all four edges, name readable and unclipped, no page horizontal scroll, at 320×568, 390×844 and 1280×800; plus a 10-card wrap/scroll test.

Shared CardFace styles needed no change (`cards.css` untouched): `.cf` fills once given a real box, and `.cf-back` is `position: absolute; inset: 0`, so unknown cards fill on their own. `TheirHand.tsx`, `CardListSheet`, and everything under `crates/`/`spec/` are untouched.

## How it was tested

- `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --spec cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx` — pre-fix **0/4 pass** (face left edge 16px inside the button at all widths, Electron reproduces the sliver class), post-fix **4/4 pass**.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/reveal.test.tsx` — 7/7 pass, R434 suite green and unchanged.
- `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` — clean. `pnpm exec eslint e2e/cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx` — clean (CSS files aren't covered by eslint config). `cargo fmt --check` — clean.
- `ui-walkthrough` at iPhone SE 320px on `/dev/hotseat`: before/after screenshots at `.cache/browse/their-hand-before.png` (syllable-per-line slivers) and `.cache/browse/their-hand-after.png` (six full readable faces). Out-of-scope check: the chip's `CardListSheet` faces measure 107.1×150 with exact fill — no same bug there (it portals to `document.body`, outside `.app-shell`, so the padding never touches it), unchanged.

## Decisions the issue didn't settle

- **Padding reset over aspect-ratio-only fix.** The issue's likely cause (WebKit aspect-ratio) is real insurance, but measured evidence in Chromium showed the padding override as the sliver's cause. Rejected alternative: explicit width alone — verified live that faces stayed 15px until the padding rule landed.
- **10-card scroll half runs at 568×320 landscape.** At portrait phone heights ten 66px cards fit under `max-height: 42vh` without scrolling, so the scroll assertion would be vacuous; landscape forces genuine overflow and also covers the media query's landscape arm.
- **Base `padding: 0` kept** alongside the qualified override (documents intent for bare mounts; mirrors the `.cf .card-name` belt-and-suspenders precedent in `cards.css`).

## For the reviewer

- WebKit/Safari still needs the issue owner's re-verify: Cypress ran Electron/Chromium. The fix removes every engine-dependent sizing path (both axes from one token, face at 100%/100%, padding explicitly zeroed), so there is nothing left for WebKit to resolve differently.
- Mid-session the Vite dev server served a stale transform (old media rule lingered post-HMR); I restarted it and curl-verified the served CSS before the after-measurements. Worth knowing if HMR ever shows a half-applied state again.
- Environment only, not delivered: Cypress binary installed by unsetting `CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY`; Xvfb run via a user-namespace bind of the cached `xkbcomp` (`~/bin/Xvfb` wrapper).

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 497s |

| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 4s |

</details>
```

# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

At 320–430 px portrait, every card in the result panel's Their hand is a full 5:7 face (about 47 × 66 px at the phone size, 66 × 92 px on desktop), with names rendering as in other small-face lists. The fix is an explicit width on `.their-hand__card` plus a face-fill rule, both in `apps/web/src/game/reveal.css`. A new Cypress component spec fails on today's 11 px slivers; the R434 vitest suite stays green, the 10-card hand still wraps and scrolls inside `max-height: 42vh` with no page-level horizontal scroll, and before/after phone screenshots go with the change.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/game/reveal.css` | change | `.their-hand__card`: new `--their-hand-h` custom property, explicit `width`, new `.their-hand__card > .cf` fill rule; existing phone media query sets the property instead of `height` |
| `e2e/cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx` | new | Layout spec: face size, fill, wrap/scroll, no page overflow, at phone and desktop widths |

Do not touch: `apps/web/src/cards/cards.css` (shared CardFace styles need no change, see step 3), `apps/web/src/game/TheirHand.tsx`, `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/*` (the `CardListSheet` dialog — measure it, step 4, but do not restyle it), anything under `crates/`, `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing notes: R434 (the section exists and reveals the opponent's hand; no behavior changes, so no new ruling note and no `spec/pending` entry) and `FACE_ASPECT` in `apps/web/src/cards/constants.ts` (already 5/7; the CSS mirrors it as a literal, following the precedent of `--list-face-h` in `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.css`).

## Steps

1. Reproduce at phone width before changing anything. Serve the client (`pnpm --dir apps/web dev --port 5173 --strictPort`, in the background; its predev builds WASM, about 2.5 minutes cold), then `sh scripts/browse.sh open "--device=iPhone SE" "http://localhost:5173/dev/hotseat?seed=42"`. Run the mulligans and concede via the dev handle: `sh scripts/browse.sh eval` an async function that waits for `window.__jackioh`, keeps the most cards on both mulligans, then dispatches the `concede`-type action from `j.legal()` for one seat. Measure the bug with `eval`: `getBoundingClientRect()` of each `.their-hand__card` and its inner `.cf` (expect about 11 × 33 on the broken build) and screenshot the section (`screenshot "getByTestId('result-their-hand')" --filename=their-hand-before.png`). If no concede-type action exists in `j.legal()`, play the game out through `dispatch` instead; do not judge hidden state, only the rendered panel.
2. Edit `apps/web/src/game/reveal.css`, `.their-hand__card` rule only: add `--their-hand-h: 92px;`, change `height: 92px;` to `height: var(--their-hand-h);`, and add `width: calc(var(--their-hand-h) * 5 / 7);` after it. This yields about 65.7 px on desktop and, via step 3's override, about 47.1 px on phones. Copy the `calc(var * 5 / 7)` pattern from `.inspect-list-grid--sheet` in `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.css`.
3. In the same file, add one rule after `.their-hand__card:focus-visible`: `.their-hand__card > .cf { width: 100%; height: 100%; }`. Then change the body of the existing `@media (max-width: 600px), (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px)` block from `height: 66px;` to `--their-hand-h: 66px;`, so width follows automatically. Shared CardFace styles need no change: `.cf` already sizes from the box it is given (`height: 100%`, `aspect-ratio: 5 / 7`), and `.cf-back` is `position: absolute; inset: 0`, so the unknown-card `<span>` case fills on its own. State this finding in the PR body.
4. Check the out-of-scope question without restyling: with the same phone viewport, open the chip's Their hand dialog (`TheirHandButton` → `CardListSheet`) and measure `.inspect-list-face` boxes the same way. If they render full 5:7, report that and change nothing there. If they show the same sliver,
(the rest of the state was cut here)

## Log
(earlier lines of the log were cut here)
- Read reveal.css, TheirHand.tsx, cards.css (.cf sizing), inspect.css (list precedent), CardBack
  (.cf-back fills), faces.ts (lookup fallback), rematch/board-layout component specs, Game/Result wiring.
- Found env: no Cypress binary, system Chrome present, no wasm pkg, 70G disk free.
- `CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY=1` means version "1" (404); unset it instead — binary 16.1.0 installed.
- Wrote `e2e/cypress/component/their-hand.cy.tsx` (4 tests; 10-card scroll half at 568x320
  landscape, where 42vh of 320px genuinely overflows two rows and the media query's landscape arm
  is covered). `typecheck:component` fails pre-existing on missing wasm pkg; building it now.
- Order from here: Cypress pre-fix (must fail) → browse before-shot → CSS fix → after-shot →
  Cypress + reveal.test.tsx + typecheck + eslint.
- Cypress pre-fix: 4/4 FAIL, face left edge 16px inside button (button 47.1 wide, face ~15).
  Live before-shot: buttons 47×66, faces 15×48; screenshot shows syllable-per-line slivers.
- DEPARTURE from plan: root cause is NOT only aspect-ratio. `.app-shell button` (index.css,
  0,1,1) pads every button 9px 16px and beats `.their-hand__card{padding:0}` (0,1,0); the face
  filled 100% of a 15px content box. Fix adds `.app-shell .their-hand__card{padding:0}` plus the
  planned explicit width and `.cf` fill; `aspect-ratio` removed (both axes explicit now).
- Vite dev served a stale transform mid-session (old media rule lingered after HMR); restarted
  dev server, curl-verified served CSS, then re-measured.
- After fix (fresh server, settled): buttons 47.1×66, faces 47.1×66, names 44px. After-shot good.
- CardListSheet (out of scope): faces 107.1×150, fill exact — NO same bug (it portals to body,
  outside `.app-shell`, so no padding). No change there.
- VERIFIED post-fix: Cypress their-hand.cy.tsx 4/4 pass (was 0/4); reveal.test.tsx 7/7;
  typecheck:component clean; eslint clean on spec (css not covered by config); cargo fmt clean.
  Tree: only `apps/web/src/game/reveal.css` modified + new spec untracked. Dev server stopped,
  browse session closed. Shots: `.cache/browse/their-hand-before.png`,
  `.cache/browse/their-hand-after.png` (gitignored, for PR attach).
